title: Garlic Lemon Shrimp Pasta
description: Quick-seared shrimp in garlic oil with whole wheat pasta, cherry tomatoes and fresh parsley.
ingredients: 350 g large shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Cook the pasta, reserving some pasta water.
Sauté the garlic in oil, add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Add the tomatoes and lemon, toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water, then finish with parsley.
notes: Shrimp's astaxanthin and tomato's lycopene are a genuinely good antioxidant pairing.
